pr_title: Detect Homebrew on Mac M1(Apple Silicon).
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY

Detect Homebew on Mac M1(Apple Silicon).

Fixes #73887

##### ISSUE TYPE

- Bugfix Pull Request

##### COMPONENT NAME

facts


##### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Homebew on Mac M1 is installed to /opt/homebrew/bin/brew.
So, PKG_MGRS should include that path.
pr_comments: @fernandoacorreia You are absolutely right. Write a unit test under `test/units/module_utils/facts/system/`. Let me know if you need any help.
closing in favor of more complete #74378

issue_context.title: fact gathering does not auto-detect homebrew on Mac with M1
issue_context.body:
### Summary

module_utils/facts/system/pkg_mgr.py does not detect homebrew on Mac with M1.

homebrew on Mac with M1 is installed to /opt/homebrew/bin/brew.
But, module_utils/facts/system/pkg_mgr.py only search '/usr/local/bin/brew'.

### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

facts

### Ansible Version

```console (paste below)
$ ansible --version
ansible 2.9.6
  config file = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/home/kimata/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/ansible
  executable location = /usr/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.8.5 (default, Jan 27 2021, 15:41:15) [GCC 9.3.0]
```


### Configuration

```console (paste below)
$ ansible-config dump --only-changed

```


### OS / Environment

Ubuntu 20.04.2 LTS

### Steps to Reproduce

<!--- Paste example playbooks or commands between quotes below -->
```console (paste below)
$ ansible macbook -m setup
```


### Expected Results

"ansible_pkg_mgr": "homebrew",



### Actual Results

<!--- Paste example playbooks or commands between quotes below -->
```console (paste below)
$ ssh macbook brew --prefix
/opt/homebrew

$ ansible macbook -m setup
(snip)
        "ansible_machine": "arm64",
        "ansible_memfree_mb": 6712,
        "ansible_memtotal_mb": 8192,
        "ansible_model": "MacBookAir10,1",
        "ansible_nodename": "macbook.green-rabbit.net",
        "ansible_os_family": "Darwin",
        "ansible_osrevision": "199506",
        "ansible_osversion": "20D91",
        "ansible_pkg_mgr": "unknown",  <---
        "ansible_processor": "Apple M1",
        "ansible_processor_cores": "8",
        "ansible_processor_vcpus": "8",
        "ansible_product_name": "MacBookAir10,1",
```

Files identified in the description:

If these files are incorrect, please update the `component name` section of the description or use the `!component` bot command.

Until #73896 is merged, I was able to work around this with:

```
- name: Set pkg_mgr for macOS
  when: ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'MacOSX'
  set_fact:
    pkg_mgr: homebrew
    cacheable: yes
```
